mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fit_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM fit_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND mobile = #{mobile} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY member_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_member_card WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_course_reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_checkin_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_schedule_student WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_training_plan WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId})
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_member SET wx_openid=NULL, wx_unionid=NULL, member_status='lost', del_flag='2', update_time=NOW() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0' AND member_status='normal'

UPDATE fit_member SET wx_openid=#{openid}, wx_unionid=#{unionid}, update_time=NOW() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0' AND member_status='normal' AND (wx_openid IS NULL OR wx_openid='')
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_member_card WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND bind_coach_id=#{coachId} AND del_flag='0') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_course_schedule WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND coach_id=#{coachId} AND del_flag='0') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_course WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND default_coach_id=#{coachId} AND del_flag='0') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND bind_coach_id=#{coachId} AND del_flag='0') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_training_plan p JOIN fit_coach c ON c.user_id=p.creator_id AND c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id WHERE c.coach_id=#{coachId} AND p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.creator_type='coach')
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_post WHERE user_id=#{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId})
